title: Drawer organizer
summary: Bins or a tool insert for a drawer, optionally on a Gridfinity grid.

questions.label: Drawer inner width
questions.why: Sets how many grid cells or how wide the insert can be.

questions.label: Drawer inner depth
questions.why: Sets the other side of the grid.

questions.label: Usable height
questions.why: The drawer must still close; measure to the lowest obstruction.

questions.label: Base system
questions.why: Gridfinity separates a reusable base from the bins.

questions.label: What goes in it, with sizes
questions.placeholder: e.g. 4 screwdrivers, 22 mm handles; a tape measure 65 x 65 x 40 mm
questions.why: Each pocket needs the measured size of its tool.

material.why: Indoor, low load, fast to print in large areas.
material.consider: PETG if the drawer is in a garage or a car.

checks.name: Pocket fit
checks.why: Each tool goes in and comes out without binding.

checks.name: Finger access
checks.why: Every tool can be gripped and lifted.

checks.name: Base mating coupon
checks.why: A single cell printed first to check it seats on the base.

checks.name: Drawer closure
checks.why: The tallest bin and tool stay below the usable height.
